requirements.summary: Build application categorization interface for managing productive and distracting applications
acceptanceCriteria: Users can view categorized applications
Users can add new applications and assign categories
Users can edit existing application categories
Default productive and distracting apps are pre-populated

file_operations.description: Define TypeScript interfaces for application categorization, including Application interface with name and category fields, and types for productive/distracting categories

Create component displaying categorized applications in two lists (productive and distracting) with add/edit functionality, using default examples including coding tools, document editors as productive, and social media, video platforms as distracting
Create custom hook managing application state in local storage, providing functions to add, update, and retrieve categorized applications with default pre-populated apps
Add routing for application categorization page and integrate AppCategorizationManager component into navigation structure

requirements.summary: Create live monitoring simulation interface displaying active application and real-time switching metrics
acceptanceCriteria: Current active application is displayed in real-time
Switch frequency metrics update live
Visual feedback indicates when switches occur
Continuous focus timer shows uninterrupted work duration

file_operations.description: Create component simulating live monitoring with current active application display, real-time switch frequency counter, continuous focus duration timer, and visual pulse indicator when context switches occur

Create custom hook simulating application switching behavior, generating context switch events, calculating switches per minute and per hour, and calling backend recordSwitch method with ContextSwitch data
Create custom hook tracking continuous focus duration, resetting on context switches, and providing formatted time display
Add routing for live monitoring page and integrate LiveMonitor component into main navigation

requirements.summary: Implement progressive warning system UI with burnout threshold notifications and visual effects
acceptanceCriteria: First warning shows gentle notification with burnout index
Second warning applies greyscale visual effect to entire interface
Warnings are dismissible but reappear if behavior continues
Visual effects scale with burnout severity

file_operations.description: Create warning notification component displaying burnout index and encouragement message with gentle styling using warm colors, dismissible but persistent based on continued behavior
Create component applying subtle greyscale CSS filter to reduce visual stimulation at high burnout threshold, with smooth transition animation

Create custom hook calculating burnout index based on switching patterns (productive-to-productive small increase, productive-to-distracting moderate increase, distracting-to-distracting large increase), tracking threshold levels, and triggering warning states
Integrate BurnoutWarning and GreyscaleOverlay components at app root level to overlay entire interface when thresholds are reached

requirements.summary: Build smart blocking interface for distracting applications after ignored warnings
acceptanceCriteria: Block screen activates after two warnings for distracting apps
Block screen displays required focus duration (20-25 minutes)
Timer counts down productive work session
Block is removed automatically after productive session completes

file_operations.description: Create full-screen blocking component displaying required productive session duration (20-25 minutes), countdown timer with progress indicator, and encouraging message about completing focus work to unlock

Create custom hook tracking warning count, activating block screen after two ignored warnings, managing productive work timer, and automatically removing block after session completes while calling backend recordSession method
Integrate BlockScreen component at app root level to display over entire interface when blocking condition is met

requirements.summary: Create desk recovery break interface with guided breathing exercises
acceptanceCriteria: Breathing exercise displays animated visual guide
Interface uses calming colors and smooth animations
Short timer (3-5 minutes) tracks desk recovery duration
Break can be started and ended from main interface

file_operations.description: Create component with animated breathing guide using expanding/contracting circle animation, calming gradient background using frontend/public/assets/generated/breathing-background.dim_1200x800.png as backdrop, and 3-5 minute timer display with start/end controls
Create custom hook managing breathing animation cycle timing (inhale/hold/exhale phases) and animation state transitions
Create custom hook managing break session timing, calling backend recordBreak method with BreakSession data including breakType deskRecovery and isRestorative classification
Add routing for desk recovery break page and integrate DeskRecoveryBreak component into navigation with quick-access button from dashboard

requirements.summary: Implement walk break timer interface with countdown and alert alarm
acceptanceCriteria: User can input desired break duration before starting walk break
Countdown timer is visible and updates in real-time
Alert sound plays when timer reaches zero
User can manually end break early if they return before timer expires

file_operations.description: Create component with duration input field, prominent countdown display updating every second, alert audio element playing sound when timer expires, and manual end break button

Create custom hook managing countdown timer state, triggering audio alert on expiration, handling manual early completion, and calling backend recordBreak method with BreakSession data including breakType walkBreak
Add alert sound audio file for walk break timer expiration notification
Add routing for walk break timer page and integrate WalkBreakTimer component into navigation with quick-access button from dashboard

requirements.summary: Build gamification achievements display with badges and share functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Achievements are displayed as visual badges with icons
Each achievement shows unlock date and criteria
Users can share achievements externally
Achievement progress is visible for locked badges

file_operations.description: Create badge component displaying achievement icon using generated badge images (frontend/public/assets/generated/badge-focus-streak.dim_256x256.png for focus streaks, frontend/public/assets/generated/badge-deep-work.dim_256x256.png for deep work milestones, frontend/public/assets/generated/badge-distraction-shield.dim_256x256.png for distraction resistance), unlock date, criteria description, and locked/unlocked state styling

Create gallery component displaying all achievements in grid layout, showing earned badges with full details and locked badges with progress indicators, including share button with copy-to-clipboard or download functionality
Create custom hook fetching achievement data from backend, calculating progress toward locked achievements, and providing share functionality
Add routing for achievements page and integrate AchievementsGallery component into main navigation

requirements.summary: Create recovery quality visualization using pie chart for break analysis
acceptanceCriteria: Pie chart displays break quality distribution
Restorative and non-restorative segments are clearly differentiated
Percentages and time durations are labeled
Chart updates based on selected time period

file_operations.description: Create pie chart component using recharts library displaying break time segmented into restorative activities (walks, breathing exercises, inactivity) and non-restorative activities (passive browsing, social media) with clear color differentiation, percentage labels, and time duration tooltips
Create custom hook aggregating break session data from backend, calculating restorative vs non-restorative percentages, and filtering by selected time period
Integrate RecoveryQualityChart component into dashboard view as analytics card

requirements.summary: Build comprehensive dashboard displaying key metrics and daily recommendations
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays all key metrics in organized card layout
Charts visualize trends over time (switching frequency, burnout index)
Productivity score is prominently displayed with visual indicator
Daily recommendations are personalized based on user patterns
Layout is clean and information is quickly scannable

file_operations.description: Create dashboard component with card-based layout displaying total focus time, distraction time, switching frequency chart, burnout index trend graph, productivity score with circular progress indicator, daily personalized recommendations, and hero section using frontend/public/assets/generated/dashboard-hero.dim_800x400.png showing focused person at desk
Create reusable card component for displaying individual metrics with title, value, trend indicator, and optional chart
Create component displaying overall productivity score as large number with circular progress visualization and color-coded indicator (green for good, yellow for moderate, red for needs improvement)
Create component displaying 3-5 personalized recommendations based on user behavior patterns, using encouraging coaching language and actionable suggestions

Create custom hook aggregating session data from backend, calculating total focus time, distraction time, switching frequency trends, burnout index over time, productivity score, and generating personalized recommendations
Set Dashboard component as default home route and ensure it is accessible from main navigation

requirements.summary: Implement periodic report view displaying positive and negative behavioral patterns
acceptanceCriteria: Report displays positive patterns with encouraging visual indicators
Negative patterns are highlighted constructively for self-correction
Patterns show week-over-week or month-over-month comparisons
Report is exportable or viewable for different time periods

file_operations.description: Create report component displaying positive patterns (consistent work sessions, healthy break timing, reduced distractions) with green checkmarks and encouraging messages, and negative patterns (late-night work fatigue, frequent context switching, distraction spikes) with constructive yellow/orange warnings and improvement suggestions, including time period selector and export button
Create component displaying individual pattern with icon, description, trend comparison, and visual indicator (positive green or constructive yellow/orange for negative patterns)

Create custom hook fetching reports from backend using getAllReports method, parsing Pattern data for positive and negative patterns, calculating week-over-week and month-over-month comparisons, and providing export functionality
Add routing for periodic report page and integrate PeriodicReport component into main navigation

requirements.summary: Design application with supportive coaching aesthetic using warm colors and encouraging design language
acceptanceCriteria: Visual design uses warm, supportive color palette (avoid harsh reds or aggressive tones)
Typography and language tone is encouraging and coaching-oriented
Interventions feel helpful rather than restrictive
Overall aesthetic conveys trust and personal growth support

file_operations.description: Extend Tailwind theme with warm, supportive color palette including soft blues, greens, and warm neutrals for primary colors, gentle yellows and oranges for warnings (not harsh reds), and calming purples for accents, avoiding aggressive or punishing color choices
Add global CSS variables for coaching aesthetic including warm base colors, soft shadows, rounded corners, and encouraging typography styles with friendly font choices and comfortable line heights

Create constants file with all user-facing text using encouraging, coaching-oriented language throughout the application, avoiding harsh or punishing terminology and emphasizing support, growth, and personal improvement
